urls.title: Audio and video URLs
urls.description: Direct links to audio or video files (MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, OPUS, FLAC, MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM and anything else FFmpeg reads), one per line. Apify key-value store record URLs are read with your token. YouTube, TikTok and Instagram page links are not supported. Billed per started minute of audio; failed files are free.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional alternative to Audio and video URLs, in Apify's request-list format (e.g. a file with one URL per line, or the output of another actor). Combined with Audio and video URLs.

keyValueStoreRecords.title: Key-value store records
keyValueStoreRecords.description: Files uploaded to an Apify key-value store, as storeId/recordKey or username~store-name/recordKey, one per line. Use this to transcribe your own recordings without hosting them anywhere.

rssFeeds.title: Podcast RSS feeds
rssFeeds.description: Podcast RSS (or Atom) feed URLs, one per line. The newest episodes of each feed are transcribed (see Max episodes per feed).

maxEpisodes.title: Max episodes per feed
maxEpisodes.description: How many of each feed's newest episodes to consider. With Only new episodes, those already transcribed by an earlier run are skipped.

onlyNewEpisodes.title: Only new episodes (monitoring)
onlyNewEpisodes.description: Skip episodes transcribed by an earlier run with the same feeds. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) to transcribe each new episode once. Failed episodes are retried next run. State is kept in the key-value store "media-transcriber-state" in your account.

model.title: Whisper model
model.description: Base: fast and cheap, good for clear speech ($0.008/min). Small: more accurate on accents, noise, names and non-English audio ($0.016/min, about 3x slower).

language.title: Language
language.description: Spoken language. Auto-detect works well for one language per file; set it for short clips, strong accents or to force a language.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: Transcript: one item per file with the full text and timestamped segments. RAG chunks: one item per chunk of about the chosen size, with start and end times, ready for a vector database. SRT and VTT subtitle files are saved and linked in both.

chunkSize.title: Chunk size (characters)
chunkSize.description: RAG chunks only. Maximum characters per chunk, overlap included. Chunks break between transcript segments. About 4 characters make one token.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap (characters)
chunkOverlap.description: RAG chunks only. Up to this many characters of whole segments repeated from the end of the previous chunk, at most half the chunk size. 0 for none.

maxDurationMinutes.title: Max duration per file (minutes)
maxDurationMinutes.description: Longer files are skipped with an error (free). Caps cost per file. At most 300.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger downloads are skipped with an error (free). Video files are large: the audio track is all that is used.

timeoutSecs.title: Download timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Max time to download one file.
